name: pullback_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, during an established 5-minute uptrend, the index periodically pulls back to session VWAP — the level at which VWAP-benchmarked institutional TWAP/VWAP execution algorithms receive fills at or better than their benchmark, triggering accelerated re-accumulation. When the VWAP deviation reaches -0.5 to -1.2 ATR units (approximately 10-25 NIFTY spot points below VWAP), both TWAP buyers improving their fill and delta-hedging market makers net long from put selling step in simultaneously, creating a 15-25 spot point bounce within 60-90 seconds. At 5-second resolution, entry on the first positive return tick after the VWAP touch captures 4-7 option points of this bounce before the index re-anchors above VWAP.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(close * volume) / cumulative(volume), reset each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure — no scaling needed. VWAP is the institutional benchmark that resets at 09:15 each day. The deviation from this specific level is what triggers TWAP algo re-accumulation.

indicators.name: atr_24
indicators.purpose: 24 bars = 2 minutes. Used to normalize VWAP deviation into dimensionless z-score units. Original used ATR(14) on 1-min bars (14 min). We compress to 2 min because we are trading a 30-90s bounce — we need ATR to reflect current micro-volatility, not a 14-minute smoothed level. A 14-min ATR would be too slow to distinguish deep pullbacks from shallow ones at 5s scale.

indicators.name: vwap_dev
indicators.purpose: VWAP deviation in ATR units. Threshold -0.5 to -1.2 corresponds to 10-25 NIFTY spot points below VWAP depending on volatility regime — the zone where VWAP-benchmarked algos actively accumulate.

indicators.name: mom_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute momentum (60 bars × 5s = 5 min). SAME time window as original's nifty_return_5 (5-min return). This is the CONTEXT FILTER — we want to confirm the pullback is happening within an established trend, not a breakdown. The 5-min window is not compressed because this is a context filter, not the trade trigger.

indicators.name: ret_1
indicators.purpose: 1-bar (5-second) return. Entry confirmation: we require the first positive tick after the VWAP dip, not the dip itself. This prevents entering into a still-falling index and captures the inflection point.

conditions: vwap_dev < -vwap_zscore_threshold (price below VWAP by threshold ATR units)
ret_1 > 0 (first positive tick — bounce has started)
vwap_dev > +vwap_zscore_threshold (price above VWAP by threshold ATR units)
ret_1 < 0 (first negative tick — rejection has started)
buy_pe.confirmation: ret_1 < 0 (first downtick after the VWAP overshoot)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points (delta ~0.5). If NIFTY falls 8 more spot points below VWAP after our entry, the pullback has become a breakdown — TWAP algo accumulation is not absorbing supply. At 30-90s holds, a continued 8-spot-pt move against us means the thesis is wrong. NIFTY typical 30s adverse move is 2-5 pts option; 4 pt stop gives room for one normal adverse wiggle.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points = ~12 NIFTY spot points. VWAP touches on NIFTY during trending days revert to VWAP and typically 5-10 pts above within 60-90 seconds — median bounce is 15-25 spot pts, we target the conservative 40% capture. 6 pts gives 1:1.5 risk-reward.

filters.vix_filter: vix < 19 (same as original) — VWAP pullbacks are unreliable when VIX is high; panic selling drives NIFTY through VWAP rather than bouncing from it
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST — skip pre-open; flatten before close
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume unreliable as signal at 5s
filters.trend_filter: mom_60 > 0 for CE / < 0 for PE — ensures pullback is against trend, not trend reversal
filters.spread_filter: none — limit orders, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — VWAP algos are common; if too many strategies target same VWAP levels, bounce may be pre-empted

adaptation_notes: Original used VWAP pullback across top-40 FnO stocks with individual stock VWAP and relative volume. Converted to NIFTY index itself: (1) Individual stock VWAP → NIFTY session VWAP, same cumulative structure; (2) nifty_return_5 filter → retained at exact same 5-min lookback as context filter; (3) Relative volume discarded — index volume is too noisy at 5s for reliable cross-bar comparison; (4) ATR(14 × 1min) compressed to ATR(24 × 5s = 2min) because we trade a 30-90s bounce rather than a 8-25 min hold — need micro-volatility context not macro; (5) Entry confirmation added (ret_1 > 0) to enter on bounce start rather than during the falling dip.
weaknesses: VWAP loses predictive power in strongly trending sessions where price stays far from VWAP all day
VIX filter at 19 may exclude regime where VWAP bounces are actually sharpest (moderate stress)
Clustering of signals at key VWAP levels means slippage could increase if many algos target same level
ATR(24) very short — may be noisy in illiquid early morning bars (09:20-09:30)
